Hi Liam — thanks for flagging this. Short answers up front:

- We can apply the $45k deposit as an offset against the renewal invoice. It won't be automatic unless we have a PO referencing the credit application; workflow below.
- For EU VAT (Ireland) we require either your Irish VAT registration number (for reverse-charge) or a VAT certificate if you expect us to zero-rate the supply. Once we have that we can reissue the invoice accordingly.

Proposed steps (to avoid delay):
1) You send a PO that includes a line: "Apply deposit credit DL-4391 — $45,000" and references the renewal invoice number once it's issued.
2) Alice (or your AP) uploads the PO and VAT number/certificate to the DocuSign link below (or replies with the PDF attached).
3) We issue the pro forma renewal invoice showing the gross amount and a credit line for the $45k; once PO is received we finalize and send the cleared invoice for your records.

DocuSign/Upload link: https://redwood.app/verify/po-upload/DL-4391

I'll loop in Marissa to confirm accounting treatment and whether we need to route this as a credit memo or direct offset to a new invoice.

Best,
